notes: Tap a muscle to see its exercises. On the Workouts tab, tap a muscle on the body map (or its chip below it) and tap See exercises: the ones in your plan come first, then the rest for your equipment, each marked Foundation, Intermediate or Advanced. If the muscle is still recovering, the list says so. An exercise page can now swap that exercise into your plan when there is one clear match. When a bodyweight move gets easy (15+ reps on every set, two workouts in a row), the workout offers its harder version with one tap, or a slower tempo when there is none. The exercise library can now be filtered by muscle.
